observations.text: Sale items (marked with a red tag) are final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange for any reason.
Items that arrive damaged or defective may be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund or replacement, regardless of item condition upon return.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of us receiving the returned item.

assumptions.text: The policy does not explicitly state which rule governs when a sale item (rule 2) also arrives damaged/defective (rule 3) — i.e., whether the 'final sale, no returns for any reason' clause overrides the damaged-item return right, or vice versa.
assumptions.why_needed: To answer whether this specific item (a red-tag sale item that arrived damaged) is returnable, we must resolve a conflict between two independently stated rules that the knowledge base never addresses jointly. Without an explicit tie-breaker, applying either rule alone would be an unlabeled leap.

backed_claims.text: If only the standard sale-item rule applied, the item would not be eligible for return since it is final sale.
backed_claims.falsification_path: Would be false if the policy stated an exception to rule 2 for damaged items.

backed_claims.text: If only the damaged-item rule applied, the item would be eligible for return within 14 days for a full refund or replacement regardless of condition, and the purchase was made 10 days ago so it falls within that window.
backed_claims.falsification_path: Would be false if the policy stated an exception to rule 3 for final-sale items, or if the item was purchased more than 14 days ago.

unverified_claims.text: Northgate Outfitters intends for the damaged/defective return right (rule 3) to override the final-sale exclusion (rule 2) for sale items that arrive damaged.
Northgate Outfitters intends for the final-sale exclusion (rule 2) to override the damaged/defective return right (rule 3), meaning damaged sale items cannot be returned.

hypotheses.text: Assuming the more common industry practice — that a damage/defect right (a remedy for the seller's/shipper's failure, not the buyer's preference) typically applies even to final-sale merchandise — the item would likely be returnable for a refund or replacement within 14 days.
hypotheses.falsification_path: Contact Northgate Outfitters customer service or find an explicit clause addressing damaged final-sale items; if they confirm final-sale items are excluded from the damage/defect remedy, this hypothesis is falsified.

conclusion.text: The knowledge base does not clearly answer this. Rule 2 says red-tag sale items are final sale and not eligible for return 'for any reason,' which on its face would exclude even damage claims. Rule 3 says damaged/defective items are returnable within 14 days 'regardless of item condition,' and your item is within that 14-day window (10 days). These two rules directly conflict for this scenario, and the policy never states which one controls when both apply. I cannot give a backed yes/no answer — you should contact Northgate Outfitters directly to confirm whether the damage/defect return right applies to final-sale items, since the policy text alone doesn't resolve it.
